responsibility: Primary front-end interface for C++ contracts support. It defines the stable enums and data structures for contract levels, semantics, roles, continuation modes, and configuration, along with tree access macros for contract AST nodes and FUNCTION_DECL attributes, plus declarations for the routines that parse, copy, remap, diagnose, lower, and emit pre/post/assert contract checks across the C++ front end.
same_name_distinction: Defines the contracts interface and representation shared across the C++ front end: enums for levels/semantics, contract-role/configuration types, DECL_/CONTRACT_ access macros, and function declarations. Unlike contracts.cc, it does not lower or emit checks; it provides the stable definitions that implementation files consume.
